regions.full_page: Eileen Sigel - 29 - on April 20 narrowelly escaped instant death - broken legs and ribs, skull and diaphram. 7-8 weeks unconscious .... Her own doctor feard only day before yester. that she would not walk for months. Mother made a pilgrimage to Carey, Ohio yesterday .... and about the time she finished the 1000 Hail Marys - the girl walks at home. Now here with her sis- ter they left the crutches in car.
